meta.description: Trees and street lights for the Gooi Digital Twin map
meta.source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API; trees also from the BGT (Basisregistratie Grootschalige Topografie), via PDOK
meta.note: Mapped trees and tree rows are at their OSM or BGT positions; forests are outlines the app fills with illustrative trees. Mapped street lamps are marked source 1; other lamps (source 0) are placed by rule along lit streets and are illustrative.
